review_candidates.title: IT Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description The Egyptian Cabinet serves as the executive branch of the Government of Egypt, overseeing the implementation of national policies, programs, and strategic initiatives. It works across ministries and public agencies to ensure effective governance, public service delivery, and sustainable development. The Cabinet increasingly relies on modern information technology to support decision-making, data management, and secure communication. Professionals joining the organization contribute to high-impact projects that affect citizens and institutions across the country. The environment values integrity, public service, and continuous improvement in administrative and digital capabilities. Role Description The IT Manager is a full-time, hybrid role based in Cairo, Egypt, with a combination of onsite work at Cabinet facilities and some work-from-home flexibility. The person in this role oversees day-to-day IT operations, including managing infrastructure, networks, and systems that support government workflows and digital services. Responsibilities include supervising an IT team, assigning tasks, monitoring performance, and ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and service requests. The IT Manager plans and implements IT projects, coordinates upgrades, maintains cybersecurity controls, and ensures data protection and compliance with relevant policies and standards. The role also involves managing vendors, optimizing budgets, documenting procedures, and collaborating with leadership and stakeholders to align IT strategy with organizational priorities. Qualifications Demonstrated ability to manage IT operations, including infrastructure, networks, servers, and end-user support in a complex organizational environment. Experience leading and coaching IT teams, managing workloads, and promoting effective collaboration and performance. Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, data protection, access control, and risk management, preferably within public sector or regulated environments. Proficiency with systems administration, enterprise software, cloud or hybrid environments, and troubleshooting hardware and software issues. Strong skills in IT project planning and execution, including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, and documentation. Ability to coordinate with vendors and service providers, manage contracts, and ensure reliable delivery of IT services. Effective communication skills to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders, prepare reports, and explain complex issues clearly. Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced certifications (e.g., ITIL, PMP, security or network certifications) are an advantage. Proven ability to work in a hybrid setting, manage priorities, and adapt to evolving organizational needs. Prior experience in government, public administration, or large-scale institutional environments is beneficial.

review_candidates.title: Quality Center Center GSM B1+
review_candidates.description: Company Description Xceed is a leading multilingual Business Process Outsourcing provider in the EMEA region, operating more than 10,000 web-enabled multichannel stations and serving government and commercial clients in 10 languages. The company has delivery centers in Egypt, Morocco, Mauritius, UAE, and a newly opened site in Saudi Arabia, offering inbound, outbound, back-office, infrastructure management, recruitment process outsourcing, helpdesk support, and social media analysis services. Xceed is widely recognized by IAOP and multiple regional and international award bodies for its outsourcing excellence, impact sourcing, customer experience, sustainability, and diversity, equity, and inclusion programs. The company maintains a strong focus on quality and resilience, supported by numerous international certifications, including COPC and several ISO standards in business continuity, information security, quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety management. Candidates joining Xceed can expect a professional environment that values development, performance, and responsible business practices. Role Description The Quality Center GSM B1+ role at Xceed is a full-time, on-site position based in Cairo, focused on monitoring and improving service quality across contact center operations. The role involves conducting regular quality audits on calls and interactions, reviewing adherence to processes and policies, and evaluating performance against established quality standards. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing quality data, identifying trends and root causes, and preparing clear reports and feedback for team leaders and operations management. The Quality Center GSM B1+ professional will collaborate closely with supervisors and trainers to recommend corrective actions, support coaching sessions, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. The role also requires maintaining accurate documentation, following quality assurance frameworks, and ensuring that customer experience and compliance objectives are consistently met. Qualifications Strong Analytical Skills with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and propose practical improvements. Proficiency in Quality Assurance practices to monitor, evaluate, and enhance service delivery standards. Experience in Quality Auditing, including conducting structured reviews of calls, interactions, and processes against defined criteria. Effective Communication skills, both written and verbal, to deliver clear feedback, collaborate with teams, and present quality findings. review_candidates.title: quality monitoring Specialist Vacancy(On Calls )
review_candidates.description: Company Description Xceed is a leading multilingual Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider in the EMEA region, operating more than 10,000 web-enabled multichannel stations. The company manages outsourcing agreements for major government and commercial clients in 10 different languages, offering services such as inbound and outbound call handling, back-office support, infrastructure management, recruitment process outsourcing, helpdesk, and social media analysis. Xceed has sites in Egypt, Morocco, Mauritius, UAE, and Saudi Arabia, providing diverse career opportunities across locations. The organization is widely recognized with multiple international awards for outsourcing excellence, customer experience, sustainability, and diversity, equity, and inclusion. Xceed also maintains a strong commitment to quality and compliance through multiple global certifications, including COPC and various ISO standards. Role Description The Quality Monitoring Specialist (On Calls) is a full-time, on-site role based in Qesm El Maadi. The specialist is responsible for monitoring and evaluating inbound and outbound calls to ensure adherence to quality standards, customer experience guidelines, and operational procedures. Daily tasks include listening to recorded or live calls, scoring performance against defined criteria, identifying gaps, and documenting findings in structured reports. The role involves providing clear feedback and coaching recommendations to team leaders and agents, collaborating with operations and training teams to address recurring issues, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. The specialist also supports the development and refinement of quality assurance frameworks, participates in calibration sessions, and helps maintain compliance with company policies and client requirements. Qualifications Experience in Telecom accounts such as Vodafone UK, WE, Orange, Etisalat, AT&T, etc. - Previous experience as a Quality Specialist/Quality Analyst or similar Quality role. - Fluent English is required. 📩 If you’re interested and meet the requirements, feel free to send your CV to Whatsapp number 01551155357
